description: Prompts designed to test and develop logical reasoning, critical thinking, and analytical skills

prompts.title: Logical Syllogism
prompts.prompt: Analyze the following syllogism and determine if the conclusion is valid: Premise 1: [premise], Premise 2: [premise], Conclusion: [conclusion]. Explain your reasoning step by step.

prompts.title: Causal Analysis
prompts.prompt: Analyze the causal relationship between [event A] and [event B]. Consider alternative explanations, confounding variables, and the strength of the causal link.

prompts.title: Argument Evaluation
prompts.prompt: Evaluate the following argument for logical fallacies, soundness, and validity: [argument]. Identify any weaknesses and suggest improvements.

prompts.title: Deductive Reasoning Problem
prompts.prompt: Solve the following deductive reasoning problem step by step: [problem]. Show your reasoning process and explain each logical step.

prompts.title: Inductive Pattern Recognition
prompts.prompt: Given the following examples: [examples], identify the pattern and predict what comes next. Explain your reasoning and the rules you identified.

prompts.title: Counterargument Generation
prompts.prompt: Generate the strongest possible counterargument to the following claim: [claim]. Consider multiple perspectives and address potential objections to your counterargument.

prompts.title: Ethical Dilemma Analysis
prompts.prompt: Analyze the following ethical dilemma using multiple ethical frameworks (utilitarianism, deontology, virtue ethics): [dilemma]. Compare the conclusions reached by each framework.

prompts.title: Probabilistic Reasoning
prompts.prompt: Calculate the probability of [event] given the following information: [information]. Show your work and explain the probability concepts used.

prompts.title: Analogical Reasoning
prompts.prompt: Analyze the following analogy: [A is to B as C is to ?]. Explain why the analogy works or doesn't work, and discuss the relevant similarities and differences.

prompts.title: Decision Tree Analysis
prompts.prompt: Create a decision tree analysis for the following decision: [decision scenario]. Include probabilities, outcomes, expected values, and a recommended course of action.

prompts.title: Scientific Hypothesis Testing
prompts.prompt: Design an experiment to test the hypothesis: [hypothesis]. Include: variables, controls, methodology, potential confounds, and how results would support or refute the hypothesis.

prompts.title: Logical Paradox Analysis
prompts.prompt: Analyze the following logical paradox: [paradox]. Explain why it's paradoxical, discuss proposed solutions, and evaluate which solution is most compelling.

prompts.title: Root Cause Analysis
prompts.prompt: Perform a root cause analysis for the following problem: [problem]. Use the 5 Whys technique and fishbone diagram approach to identify underlying causes.

prompts.title: Game Theory Scenario
prompts.prompt: Analyze the following scenario using game theory: [scenario]. Identify players, strategies, payoffs, and determine the Nash equilibrium if one exists.

prompts.title: Bias Detection
prompts.prompt: Identify potential cognitive biases in the following reasoning/argument: [content]. Explain each bias, how it affects the reasoning, and how to mitigate it.

prompts.title: Conditional Logic Problem
prompts.prompt: Solve the following conditional logic problem: If [condition A], then [result A]. If [condition B], then [result B]. Given that [situation], what can you conclude? Show your reasoning.

prompts.title: Bayesian Reasoning
prompts.prompt: Apply Bayesian reasoning to update the probability of [hypothesis] given new evidence: [evidence]. Show the prior probability, likelihood, and posterior probability calculations.

prompts.title: Systems Thinking Analysis
prompts.prompt: Analyze [system/situation] using systems thinking. Identify feedback loops, stocks and flows, leverage points, and unintended consequences of interventions.

prompts.title: Abductive Reasoning
prompts.prompt: Given the observations: [observations], generate the most likely explanation using abductive reasoning. Consider multiple hypotheses and explain why one is the best explanation.

prompts.title: Logical Consistency Check
prompts.prompt: Check the following set of statements for logical consistency: [statements]. If inconsistencies exist, identify them and suggest modifications to achieve consistency.
